answer_1.quote: To evaluate on the text generation task, We finetuned Gemma2-2b with our methods on MetaMathQA and evaluated on 5-shot GSM8K. Furthermore, for code generation tasks, we fine-tuned Llama3-8b with our methods and evaluated on the HumanEval and MBPP benchmarks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for math problems and code snippets

answer_2.quote: In the results, we reported the match accuracy for MNLI, Pearson correlation for STS-B, flexible extract and strict match scores for GSM8K, Pass@1 for Hu-manEval and MBPP, and accuracy values for other tasks.
